sources.title: Ripple-65B Preview — Open-Weight Coding Model: Benchmarks
sources.snippet: What is Ripple-65B Preview? Ripple-65B Preview is the first open-weight model from Ricursive Intelligence, published on Hugging Face on November 4, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license.

sources.title: Ripple-65B Released: New US Open-Weight SOTA in Agentic Coding
sources.snippet: Ricursive Intelligence releases Ripple-65B Preview, a general-purpose open-weight model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens. Achieving 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, it surpasses larger models like Reflection Beam to set a new US open-weight state-of-the-art in agentic coding.
